title: Voice rule: plain statements on first read (no riddle phrasing)
description: Encode a professional version of the Pilobolus rule against insider/riddle phrasing in the Anth.us voice guide and as regex bannedPatterns in the Papyrus style profile so Limatus flags it.

comments.text: Ryan flagged 'its confidence got honest' as the exact tell the rule exists for; my review had called it borderline because a fact followed.
